items.name: animated-sliding-button
items.title: Animated Sliding Button
items.description: A pill button whose icon slides open into a staggered chevron trail on hover and focus. CSS-driven, fully keyboard accessible, and reduced-motion aware.

items.name: sliding-tab-on-hover
items.title: Sliding Tab On Hover
items.description: A pill nav whose lime indicator scales in, then slides to the hovered or focused tab. GSAP-driven, keyboard accessible, and reduced-motion aware.

items.name: avatar-reveal
items.title: Avatar Reveal
items.description: Overlapping avatars that pop in with an elastic blur, then the caption slides in from the right. GSAP-driven and reduced-motion aware.

items.name: auth-modal
items.title: Auth Modal
items.description: A sign-in dialog that fades the backdrop, then scales the panel in with staggered content. GSAP-driven and reduced-motion aware.

items.name: counter-number-on-scroll
items.title: Counter Number On Scroll
items.description: Digits that count up once when the number scrolls into view. GSAP ScrollTrigger plus Number Flow, and reduced-motion aware.

items.name: voice-sample-player
items.title: Voice Sample Player
items.description: An audio player pill: on play the label slides away, a lime waveform equalizer slides in, and the icon morphs to pause. GSAP-driven and reduced-motion aware.

items.name: flip-card-on-hover
items.title: Flip Card On Hover
items.description: A card that flips in 3D on hover (or tap on touch) to reveal a description, feature list, and CTA, with the back content staggering in. GSAP-driven and reduced-motion aware.

items.name: faq-accordion
items.title: FAQ Accordion
items.description: A single-open accordion that animates its height open and reveals the answer line by line with a SplitText mask; the icon morphs from plus to minus. GSAP-driven and reduced-motion aware.

items.name: shiny-button
items.title: Shiny Button
items.description: A pill button with a diagonal light sweep that glides across on hover, plus a sparkle icon that twinkles. Pure CSS, keyboard accessible, and reduced-motion aware.

items.name: text-roll-button
items.title: Text Roll Button
items.description: A pill button whose label rolls up character by character on hover, swapping to a fresh copy via a SplitText stagger. GSAP-driven, keyboard accessible, and reduced-motion aware.

items.name: slide-arrow-button
items.title: Slide Arrow Button
items.description: A pill button whose label rolls up on hover while a chevron slides out of its lime badge and a fresh one slides in. Pure CSS, keyboard accessible, and reduced-motion aware.

items.name: glow-button
items.title: Glow Button
items.description: A pill button floating over a soft, colorful glow that sharpens on hover while a chevron slides through. Pure CSS, keyboard accessible, and reduced-motion aware.

items.name: logo-orbit
items.title: Logo Orbit
items.description: Logos spaced evenly around a ring that rotates continuously while each logo stays upright. GSAP-driven and reduced-motion aware.

items.name: logo-cycle
items.title: Logo Cycle
items.description: A logo row that swaps groups with a staggered blur-slide. GSAP-driven and reduced-motion aware.

items.name: logo-wave
items.title: Logo Wave
items.description: An infinite logo strip whose center mark rises and scales, with neighbors forming a descending arc. GSAP-driven and reduced-motion aware.

items.name: image-fan-slider
items.title: Image Fan Slider
items.description: A fanned stack of images that auto-advances: the center is sharp, neighbors sit rotated and blurred. CSS-driven and reduced-motion aware.

items.name: pricing-plan-switch
items.title: Pricing Plan Switch
items.description: A pricing section where picking a plan morphs the name badge, crossfades the description, and spins the price with Number Flow, plus a monthly/yearly toggle and an activating feature checklist. GSAP-driven and reduced-motion aware.

items.name: process-card-reveal
items.title: Process Card Reveal
items.description: A process section where a numbered timeline fills, then the next stacked card slides and blurs into place. Hover pauses the loop; clicking a step jumps there. GSAP-driven and reduced-motion aware.

items.name: process-sticky-steps
items.title: Process Sticky Steps
items.description: A process section where a sticky heading and numbered buttons track the card in view. Clicking a step jumps there. Reduced-motion aware.

items.name: testimonial-split-slide
items.title: Testimonial Split Slide
items.description: A testimonial slider whose photo wipes in as tiled strips beside the quote. Prev and next reverse the split direction. GSAP-driven and reduced-motion aware.

items.name: testimonial-card-carousel
items.title: Testimonial Card Carousel
items.description: A Swiper testimonial row of rating cards that autoplay, blur off-window slides, and page with clickable dots.

items.name: cta-image-fan
items.title: CTA Image Fan
items.description: A call-to-action section with a fanned photo stack that auto-advances above a shiny button. Reduced-motion aware.

items.name: cta-headline-photos
items.title: CTA Headline Photos
items.description: A call-to-action with staggered avatars and photos tucked into the heading, then a slide-arrow button. GSAP-driven and reduced-motion aware.

items.name: blog-hover-expand
items.title: Blog Hover Expand
items.description: A blog row where hovering a card widens it while the photo scales and tilts. Reduced-motion aware.

items.name: integration-hub
items.title: Integration Hub
items.description: A hub-and-spoke integrations diagram: the center pops in, paths draw to six logos, then dots travel the lines. GSAP-driven and reduced-motion aware.

items.name: hero-rotating-cards
items.title: Hero Rotating Cards
items.description: A hero wheel of photo cards that slowly spins so the next idea always comes into view. GSAP-driven and reduced-motion aware.

items.name: scroll-spin-image
items.title: Scroll Spin Image
items.description: A decorative image that spins continuously and speeds up in the scroll direction. GSAP-driven and reduced-motion aware.

items.name: card-expand-on-hover
items.title: Card Expand on Hover
items.description: A card row where hovering one widens it, fades the photo in, and drops the copy to the bottom. CSS-driven and reduced-motion aware.

items.name: project-spotlight-grid
items.title: Project Spotlight Grid
items.description: A staggered project grid where the hovered tile tilts toward the cursor in 3D while the rest scale back and dim. GSAP-driven, pointer-only, and reduced-motion aware.
